papers.title: Phi-4 Technical Report
papers.fact: Describes a 14-billion-parameter model and a training recipe incorporating synthetic data.
papers.question: Does data quality improve task performance at a lower serving cost?
papers.limit: Reported benchmarks require independent reproduction; model size alone does not establish total cost.

papers.title: Gemini 2.5 Technical Report
papers.fact: Documents the Gemini 2.X family, including Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash.
papers.question: Which workloads benefit from reasoning and multimodal capability?
papers.limit: Provider evaluations are not evidence of customer adoption or profitability.

papers.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
papers.quote: multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage
papers.fact: Presents foundation models and empirical evaluation, including a 405B-parameter model.
papers.question: When does self-hosting offer control worth its infrastructure cost?
papers.limit: Assess licence terms, operating costs and task-specific results separately.

papers.title: Enterprise Reference Architecture
papers.fact: Vendor reference architecture for enterprise AI infrastructure.
papers.question: What hardware, networking and integration demand would this design imply?
papers.limit: A vendor design is not proof of orders, margins or market share; PDF retrieval may depend on the provider.

papers.title: Economic Index: Cadences
papers.fact: Examines Claude usage rhythms, outputs and initial user-survey findings.
papers.question: Which tasks show sustained use, and where might demand develop?
papers.limit: Platform-specific observations and user expectations do not measure the whole labour market or causal job displacement.

papers.title: Harnessing the value of AI
papers.fact: Examines strategies for scaling enterprise AI responsibly and effectively.
papers.question: What would turn a pilot into measurable recurring business value?
papers.limit: Consultancy survey evidence is not an audited forecast of any company’s revenue.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.fact: Introduces and evaluates retrieval-augmented generation on knowledge-intensive tasks.
papers.question: Does retrieval improve grounded answers on the actual business corpus?
papers.limit: Retrieval is not a guarantee of truth, safe disclosure or current information.

papers.title: AI Labour Market Survey 2025
papers.fact: Reports employer skills gaps, recruitment difficulties and adoption intentions.
papers.question: What evidence of experience would address the reported hiring barriers?
papers.limit: Survey respondents are not the entire workforce; recommendations are G&T’s views, not government policy.
